\section[a comunidade]{a comunidade — the community}

\label{lesson:PT-C367-comunidade}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the immigration, then the Portuguese for the integration.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a comunidade}
\textbf{a comunidade} — \textquotedblleft{}the community\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
A comunidade do bairro organizou uma festa.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{The neighbourhood community organised a party.}
\end{quote}

\emph{A comunidade portuguesa} — the Portuguese community abroad.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{comunidade} is a learned borrowing from Latin \emph{commūnitās} \textquotedblleft{}community, fellowship\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB, Lewis \& Short), built on \emph{commūnis} \textquotedblleft{}common\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{a comunidade}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{a comunidade}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{a comunidade}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Portuguese for the immigration, then the Portuguese for the integration, then say \emph{a comunidade} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does a comunidade mean? (\textquotedblleft{}The community\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[a associação]{a associação — the association, the club}

\label{lesson:PT-C367-associacao}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the integration, then the Portuguese for the community.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a associação}
\textbf{a associação} — \textquotedblleft{}the association, the club\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Ela é sócia de uma associação de moradores.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{She is a member of a residents' association.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Associação de estudantes} — students' union.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{associação} is built on \emph{associar} \textquotedblleft{}to join together\textquotedblright{}, a learned borrowing from Latin \emph{associāre} \textquotedblleft{}to join to, to unite with\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short), on \emph{socius} \textquotedblleft{}companion, partner\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[o voluntário]{o voluntário — the volunteer; voluntary}

\label{lesson:PT-C367-voluntario}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the community, then the Portuguese for the association.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o voluntário}
\textbf{o voluntário} — \textquotedblleft{}the volunteer; voluntary\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Os voluntários limparam a praia no sábado.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{The volunteers cleaned the beach on Saturday.}
\end{quote}

As an adjective, voluntary: \emph{trabalho voluntário}. Feminine \emph{a voluntária}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{voluntário} is a learned borrowing from Latin \emph{voluntārius} \textquotedblleft{}willing, of free will, voluntary\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB, Lewis \& Short), built on \emph{voluntās} \textquotedblleft{}will\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{velle} \textquotedblleft{}to want\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[a caridade]{a caridade — the charity}

\label{lesson:PT-C367-caridade}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the volunteer, then the Portuguese for the voluntary work.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a caridade}
\textbf{a caridade} — \textquotedblleft{}the charity\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Deram o dinheiro todo a uma instituição de caridade.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{They gave all the money to a charity.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Instituição de caridade} — charity organisation.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{caridade} is inherited from Latin \emph{cāritās} \textquotedblleft{}dearness, love\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB, Lewis \& Short), built on \emph{cārus} \textquotedblleft{}dear\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
